briefTitle: LUNG-05: Investigating Chemotherapy Effectiveness for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) Metastatic Patients

typedChecks.sourceText: Age ≥ 18 years of age at time of consent
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Age ≥ 18 years of age at time of consent

typedChecks.sourceText: Advanced non-small cell lung cancer to meet histologically confirmed Stage IV NSCLC documented by biopsy.
typedChecks.stringValue: Stage III NSCLC who have received at least 1 line of systemic therapy may be considered eligible, pending principal investigator approval.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Advanced non-small cell lung cancer to meet histologically confirmed Stage IV NSCLC documented by biopsy.

typedChecks.sourceText: Patients have received at least 1 prior line of systemic therapy for Stage IV NSCLC, including but not limited to targeted therapy, and are currently candidates for 2L or later SOC chemotherapy.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Patients have received at least 1 prior line of systemic therapy for Stage IV NSCLC, including but not limited to targeted therapy, and are currently candidates for 2L or later SOC chemotherapy.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Demonstrates adequate organ function; labs must be within treatment parameters for the individual institutional treatment plans for specific therapeutic agents.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Exceptionally, patients with Stage III NSCLC who have received at least 1 line of systemic therapy may be considered eligible, pending principal investigator approval.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Stage III eligibility is subject to investigator approval and depends on prior line history.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Demonstrates adequate organ function; labs must be within treatment parameters for the individual institutional treatment plans for specific therapeutic agents.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Lab cutoffs depend on individual institutional plans for specific therapeutic agents rather than a fixed study-wide threshold.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must have not received any cancer treatment for at least 2 weeks.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window is not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must be a candidate for small molecule drug treatment.
